note: Second on-device session, adding MobileNetV3-Small and ResNet-18 to complete the six-architecture set. It contains ONLY the two architectures measured in July; the four architectures of the paper Table 4 were measured in the separate February session recorded verbatim in benchmark_2026-02_4arch.json. The two files together form the six-architecture reconciliation reported by analysis/table4_ondevice.py. No row here appears in the published Table 4. Both sessions used the same bench_input.npy, the same script defaults (20 runs after 3 warmups) and onnxruntime 1.24.2 with 4 intra-op threads.
